array-sum.python:
import sys
tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
if not tokens or int(tokens[0]) == 0:
    print(0)
else:
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    print(sum(nums))

move-zeroes.python:
import sys
tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
if tokens:
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    non_zeros = [x for x in nums if x != 0]
    zeros = [0] * (len(nums) - len(non_zeros))
    print(' '.join(map(str, non_zeros + zeros)))

contains-duplicate.python:
import sys
tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
if tokens:
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    has_dup = len(nums) != len(set(nums))
    print('true' if has_dup else 'false')

is-palindrome.python:
import sys
text = sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\r\n')
filtered = [c.lower() for c in text if c.isalnum()]
print('true' if filtered == filtered[::-1] else 'false')

count-vowels.python:
import sys
text = sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\r\n')
vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
v_count = sum(1 for ch in text if ch in vowels)
c_count = sum(1 for ch in text if ch.isalpha() and ch not in vowels)
print(f'Vowels: {v_count}, Consonants: {c_count}')

check-anagram.python:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
s1 = ''.join(lines[0].split()) if len(lines) > 0 else ''
s2 = ''.join(lines[1].split()) if len(lines) > 1 else ''
print('true' if sorted(s1) == sorted(s2) else 'false')

first-non-repeating.python:
import sys
from collections import Counter
text = sys.stdin.read().strip()
counts = Counter(text)
found = '-1'
for ch in text:
    if counts[ch] == 1:
        found = ch
        break
print(found)
